scenes.heading: Ask what they've already tried first

sents.d: Ask what they've already tried first
What a prospect has already tried tells you more than anything else on the call.
Almost nobody arrives having done nothing about their problem.
Ask them to walk you through what they tried and why each attempt fell short.

scenes.heading: Aim your offer at the gap

sents.d: If accountability is what broke last time, explain how your weekly check ins handle that.
You are not inventing a pitch, you are pointing at the hole they just described.

take: What already failed is where your pitch should start.
